subject: [PATCH v2 04/12] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the collapse interface

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file, mm/collapse.h, to separate the interface and implementation of the collapse feature from khugepaged.c. The header file defines an enum for scan results and a struct for collapse control, as well as two constants that were previously defined in khugepaged.c. This separation is intended to draw a clear line between the user and engine sides of the collapse mechanism, improving maintainability and modularity.
